hook: An open-weight medical model with 560 billion parameters

beats.say: Ant Ling released LingSante-3.1-flash, an open-weight mixture of experts model with 560 billion total parameters and 25 billion active per token.
It moves beyond medical question answering toward real healthcare work, from complex medical reasoning to long clinical workflows, while keeping general skills.
Ant Ling reports 65.72 on HealthBench Professional and 94.10 on BrowseComp, and says it beats GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon on its headline benchmarks.
